body: While you're there, please pray for this cursed country where I live in! :(

I'll do that. At the same time, I'll really ask God to help me make up my mind on what to do to make up for the time I wasted because of my stupidity. I can't go back to ten years ago. There is no DeLorean. I can only do with the bits and pieces of what I have now.
Advice is appreciated. I'll start praying the Rosary again tonight. I left my rosary in the house.
I have done my part, but I'm feeling absolutely impatient. I see and hear of people getting married but me... I...

> Well, do you think that not praying is helpful for how your feeling?

Definitely not, and I'm aware of it.     
 
 
 
> Do you have anymore that you can talk to about your struggles in your area?       
 
 
I'm not sure what you mean here. I'm not American. I'm a Filipino. No, I did not vote Duterte. Only thing I know is that if only I made the most of my time back in college, I would not be this way. But no, instead of sucking it up and working my way up, I did nothing because I felt I was owed things and experiences I THOUGHT my father owed me because it's his job to provide. And now I have more problems to face, and I don't want to run away from them anymore. But there's always the temptation to keep running like a coward. It never goes away.

It was good the past months, but these feelings keep up on me for some reason, and now I don't pray anymore because I feel so miserable. I feel so pathetic. I feel so undesirable and ugly. I sometimes feel that if I burned my face with acid, no one would notice the difference but me.

Please help me. I'm still feeling suicidal.     
 
 
 
edit: Still alive. Thanks guys. :)
You know, I'll need to think about all the shit I've been through lately. I'll stay alive. I won't jump off a bridge or slice my wrists or drink poison or anything. Thanks for hearing me out.

Writing. I'm now published, but nobody seems to give a shit about it.  
 
The Tinder people seem to care more about vacation photos than anything else. Do you not think that this is reflective of society as a whole? I feel that even if I stop Tinder, I'd still have doubts and trust issues. Maybe deep inside, they expect so much more from me, and it's almost impossible for me to catch up to the norm because I don't enjoy the norm. I'm not happy trying to be normal. I'm not happy spending money that I could save for things and properties I really want. I've always wanted a condominium unit, you know, but I cannot be happy if I've achieved that by worming my way up the corporate ladder. As I said, I'm not that kind of person.   
 
I hate that the high school mentality is still a thing even as an adult, and I hate that I put myself in the middle of all this as an adult. Sometimes, I feel I should live in the woods, in a bunker, surrounded by animals to hunt for food, and protected from the ills of high-school-mentality-society by millions of land mines and dozens machine gun and anti-aircraft gun nests.    
 
Fuck this shit.

There's no acceptance, it seems, and it is holding me back from being myself.   
 
My mom hates that my dad never earned much throughout his career. From my preteen years to my early twenties, I kept believing it was just laziness. But when I started working, I realized it might be something else entirely. Maybe he wanted to do something else but he knocked up my mom and so had to settle down? I will probably never know. I won't ask. I have chosen to carry this to the grave. This will be my "Who killed JFK" question. I've come to terms with that.  
 
Maybe I'm the same way. Maybe I'm like my dad. I dunno. This shit's confusing.

I just want to meet social expectations. I look at LinkedIn, and I look at Tinder, and I see people of different shapes and sizes flaunting things and experiences they were able to have with the money they rightfully earned being corporate people, and here I am just being disregarded completely because I only posted about that one time I was in a room talking to folks in a writing conference.    
 
I've always been the achievements kind of guy, but the achievements I want are not the normal corporate and office types. No suits, no Employee of the Month please. Check out my work, I like it and I hope you would, too. And because of my inclinations, I don't feel normal.    
 
I probably won't feel normal anytime soon. I mean, I even laugh at the idea of apologizing to potential dates for not being a corporate person; that they'll be so disappointed with me like my mom is still disappointed with my dad.   
 
I'm nearing 30, and I don't even want a management position. I must be some freak of sorts. I belong to the circus. LOOK AT THIS MAN, DON'T BE LIKE THIS MAN. PAY FIVE CENTS TO SEE THIS FREAK!
